summary: Narrow campus service lane under trees; authorised vehicles only, no room to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane between buildings and trees

drivers.seclusion: Only university buildings within 0-30 m; no homes close, but the lane is a managed campus service route.
drivers.access_and_room: One-lane sealed service road with building edges and dense trees either side; no shoulder or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Service and construction traffic to the new building to the north; busy car park at the south end.
drivers.convention: Authorised-only no stopping sign 7am-9pm; no vehicles parked along the kerb.

flags: Construction site beside the lane in 2022 image
Low-lying at about 8 m near the south end
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the lane, mostly from the east.
